summary: Two bedroom ground flat · Great Sandyford location · Available now · South-West facing yard
description:
A light & airy two bedroom flat in an excellent Sandyford location.

My Property Box welcome to the Lettings market this delightful two bedroom flat on Greystoke Avenue, Sandyford.

Situated on the end of the terrace, the ground floor flat comprises; entrance hallway, large front double bedroom, second rear double bedroom, central living room following through to galley kitchen, family bathroom & private rear yard.

Newly decorated & carpeted throughout, the well presented property makes for an ideal home for a couple or two sharers who desire plenty of space and natural light as well as a great Sandyford location. Available now, furnished. to arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
